# REMO World (https://remoworld.com)

> REMO World is a free bilingual (English & French) 4D World Cities platform combining 4D Focus TV Ambient City Windows, Synced Pomodoro Lofi Study Rooms, 56 ad-free live World City Radio stations across 24 metropolises, 1910 vs 2026 historical city Time-Warp comparisons, a 30-Second Daily City Challenge, Daily World Blitz 60s trivia with 1v1 duels, My Travel Score (/24) checklist, Soul City personality quiz, Dual-City First-Class 4D Boarding Pass generator, and a free embeddable Notion & Blog Live City Widget Studio.

## Key Free Features & Studios (Zero Sign-Up Required to Explore)
- [REMO World Live Social App](https://remoworld.com/): Real-time cross-city social feed, 1910 vs 2026 Before/After visual moments, 30s Daily City Challenge (`?open=daily`), live City Wars, Citizen Passports, and collectible 4D City Cards.
- [4D Focus TV — Ambient City Windows & Zen Clock](https://remoworld.com/focus-tv.html): Fullscreen 4D Focus TV window with rain/snow/neon/fireplace FX, Fly Random teleportation, Live Rain/Night city filters, Custom Vibe Links (`?tv=city&fx=rain`), and Minimal Zen Desk Clock mode.
- [Synced Study Together Rooms](https://remoworld.com/study-room.html): Shareable Focus Together Room URLs (`?tv=tokyo&fx=rain&room=study42`) with synchronized Pomodoro sessions and ad-free Lofi radio.
- [My Travel Score (/24) World Checklist](https://remoworld.com/travel-score.html): Interactive 24-city visited checklist with Explorer Tiers and free 9:16 HD Story PNG export (`?open=travelmap`).
- [Soul City Personality Quiz](https://remoworld.com/soul-city-quiz.html): 5-question personality quiz matching visitors to 1 of 24 world cities with 6 archetypes and a 9:16 HD Soul City certificate (`?open=soulcity`).
- [4D Panoramic Dual-City Boarding Pass Generator](https://remoworld.com/boarding-pass.html): Create & download First-Class 9:16 Story Boarding Passes with dual-city skylines, jetliner artwork, live clocks, and flight time (`?open=boardingpass&dep=chisinau&arr=montreal`).
- [Free Notion & Blog Live City Widget Studio](https://remoworld.com/widget.html): Embed a live world city clock, Open-Meteo real-time °C weather, and 1-click local radio badge into Notion or any HTML site (24 cities × 4 neon themes × EN/FR).
- [Daily World Blitz 60s & 1v1 Duels](https://remoworld.com/world-blitz.html): 5 daily world cities solved in 60 seconds with shareable Wordle-style result cards and URL-encoded 1v1 challenge links (`?open=blitz&vs=...`).
- [REMO Odyssey Official 4D World Runner](https://remoworld.com/odyssey.html): Browser action & hover-coin game across 24 real city skylines with live weather surges and 1v1 Ghost duels.
- [Free Live World Cities Radio (56 Stations)](https://remoworld.com/world-radio.html): Stream live radio from Paris, Montréal, Chișinău (RMO — 8 live stations), Bucharest (OTP), New York, London, Tokyo, Seoul, Berlin, Dubai, Lisbon, Amsterdam, Sydney, Rio, Singapore & Cairo + Lofi, Jazz & Synthwave.
- [Guess The City Photo Game](https://remoworld.com/guess-the-city.html): Free browser geography & skyline photo guessing game created by real citizens worldwide.
- [Top 24 World Cities Live Ranking & City Comparisons](https://remoworld.com/world-ranking.html): Real-time city standings, interactive [City Versus Duels](https://remoworld.com/city-versus.html), and 12 dedicated head-to-head city comparison guides.
- [Official REMO City Ambassadors Program](https://remoworld.com/ambassadors.html): Founding program for city creators and Study With Me streamers.
- [All 24 Connected World Cities Directory](https://remoworld.com/cities/index.html): Live local time, weather, 1910 vs 2026 history, verified facts, radio streams & urban stats for every Edition-1 metropolis.
